_comment: Corrections to upstream webappanalyzer rules. 'remove' drops exact upstream pattern strings; 'disable' drops a technology. Each entry says why. The update script reports entries that stop matching.

Sirvoy._why: svSession is Wix's own session variable, so every Wix site was reported as using Sirvoy. The JS global SirvoyBookingWidget (deep mode) remains.

Apple iCloud Mail._why: apple-domain-verification TXT records come from Apple Business / Sign in with Apple, not iCloud Mail (Prospeo reports iCloud on 3,073 US SaaS domains because of this). MX and the icloud SPF redirect remain.

Zoho Mail._why: transmail.net is ZeptoMail, Zoho's transactional email service, not Zoho Mail. Moved to the ZeptoMail overlay entry; Zoho Mail gets MX rules instead.

Microsoft 365._why: An MS= tenant token only proves the domain was verified with Microsoft (Teams, Entra, Office), not that mail is on Microsoft 365; it contradicted Google Workspace MX on real sites. The email classifier still uses it to see through gateways.

Linear._why: linear-domain-verification belongs to Linear.app (issue tracking), not the real-estate payments product this entry describes. Moved to 'Linear App'.
